why: Taking a type means taking all its servers (health is positive), so collapse servers into one total per type with a hash map. Choosing up to k types to maximise the sum is then picking the k largest totals.
hints: Once you decide to use a type, is there any reason to leave one of its servers out?
No: every health is positive. So each type is worth the sum of its servers' health, and you want the k most valuable types.
Sum health per type in a dict in O(n), sort the totals descending (or use a heap of size k) and add the first k. O(n log n).
pitfalls: Rank types by their total health, not by their single best server.
There may be fewer than k distinct types; then take them all.
The published explanation of example 2 mislabels the types: the answer 20 comes from types 2 and 5 (10 + 10), since types 1 and 3 total only 3 each.
